note: Known failures and unsupported behavior at the start of the benchmark. A later report marks each as still failing or fixed; nothing here blocks a release.

known.description: Chat cannot change a business fact (phone, email, hours, address); only Business details can.
Adding, removing or renaming a page on the owner's request fails at finish (page list frozen on edits).
An owner-given link (Facebook, Yelp, booking) is rejected unless it was on the old site.
Owner-stated prices, specials, years in business, warranties and ratings are blocked.
A second phone, email or location cannot be represented; a replaced value is banned site-wide.
Legal pages cannot be edited, moved or removed on the owner's request.
Booking, payment and portal links cannot be retired and must appear on every page.
A phone saved with an extension or two numbers makes the site unable to show its own number.
Horizontal scrolling galleries are flagged as clipped content and block release.
Proof toggles and link updates wait for an operator approval no screen can give.
The owner's chat message appears only after the send request and a full workspace reload.
Behavior of a second chat message while an edit is running is undefined; the benchmark records what happens.
Replacing a photo requires uploading it in Business details; chat has no upload.
A failed write of an agent activity log record to R2 (e.g. a Cloudflare 10043 error) fails the whole build; telemetry writes should not be fatal.
